subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I know they have a most good detective on the payroll.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the phrase "**a most good**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**a very good**" or "**an excellent**."
 
• The term** "most" is used incorrectly here.** It should be either **"very"** or another appropriate adjective.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I know they have a **very** good detective on the payroll."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: No error** – This option is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: I know they** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: detective on the payroll.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
